# Your rights in the retail industry
### Your Pay
- **$32.45**

###### Standard Hourly Rate
- **$32.45**

###### After 6PM Mon - Fri & all day Saturday
- **$32.45**

###### Sunday Rate
These pay rates are the General Retail Industry Award rates of pay.

## Common retail industry questions
##### [How much do retail workers get paid per hour in Australia?](https://www.sda.au/your-rights/your-rights-in-the-retail-industry/#accordion_9_tab_0)
Under the General Retail Industry Award, a **permanent adult retail employee (21+)** earns a base rate **from $27.81/hour (Level 1) to $33.99/hour (Level 8)**.
